ambient_coordinates.bit_order: x_0,...,x_11; bit 1 multiplies the corresponding fixed magnitude by -1 mod 5

boolean_indicator.note: The full indicator has degree 8, although its zero-locus description needs only four linear and three quadratic equations.

boundary: The coordinate model depends on the fixed Pass-540 magnitude frame; its cardinality and spectral meaning are intrinsic under the magnitude stabilizer.

quadratic_model.structure: F2^4 times a five-point quadratic core; equivalently a union of five parallel affine 4-cubes.

spectral_definition.statement: The same set is exactly the level set e4=e4(target), so the quadratic Boolean model and quartic cyclotomic invariant define one identical 80-word fibre.
